prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE transparent 3×3 sprite atlas of nine distinct 2D cartoon pilot portraits for game cards. Input image is REFERENCE ONLY. Use the same relative bust size, eye-line and viewpoint in all cells. Leave at least 70 pixels of genuine alpha transparency along every cell edge and grid gutter. No overlap, no character spanning multiple cells, no merged faces. All nine backgrounds fully transparent, not colored panels. Do not draw any grid lines.
